deepDiveBlocks.heading: Beyond Vaccinations Alone
paragraphs: Travel health consultations review your full itinerary, medical history and planned activities — covering vaccines, malaria prophylaxis, altitude illness and travel precautions in one structured appointment.
Complex multi-country trips may need longer planning horizons than a single-vaccine appointment.

preparationGuide: Activity plans including rural or adventure travel
timelineNotes: 8+ weeks before: ideal for complex itineraries
Consultation creates combined vaccine and health plan
comparisonPoints: May recommend specialist referral for complex medical cases
